description: Your own product's brand playbook — name, description and the playbook text — if one has been configured, in the dashboard or by a previous analyze_product run. Read-only: never creates or edits a playbook itself. Returns available: false when none exists yet. Takes appId (optional when your workspace has only one product). No cost to call. Use when a task needs the product's stored brand voice or positioning.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

name: get_brand_playbook

available.description: false when no playbook has been configured yet.

brand_playbook.description: The playbook text itself, or null when unavailable.

title: Get Brand Playbook
